key: If there's anything you need in your time here, please just ask one of the staff.
en: If there's anything you need in your time here, please just ask one of the staff.
ja: ここでの滞在中に何か必要なことがあれば、遠慮なくスタッフにお尋ねください。

key: Oh, I beg your pardon, you're not staying here? My apologies...
en: Oh, I beg your pardon, you're not staying here? My apologies...
ja: あら、失礼しました、ここに滞在しているわけではないんですね? すみません……

key: Hello! Welcome to the Blacksteam Shelter.
en: Hello! Welcome to the Blacksteam Shelter.
ja: こんにちは! ブラックスチーム避難所へようこそ。

key: If you need a place to stay for the night, or if your previous home is out of commission due to renovations, our doors are always open.
en: If you need a place to stay for the night, or if your previous home is out of commission due to renovations, our doors are always open.
ja: 一晩の宿が必要な方や、改修工事で以前の家が使えなくなった方のために、うちの扉はいつでも開いています。

key: If you need to check in for a stay, please register at the administrative office on the third floor.
en: If you need to check in for a stay, please register at the administrative office on the third floor.
ja: 滞在のためのチェックインが必要な方は、3階の事務所で登録をお願いします。

key: Mayne people here, they real cool and all, sayin' they'll build homes for us and we can stay here for free in the meantime.
en: Mayne people here, they real cool and all, sayin' they'll build homes for us and we can stay here for free in the meantime.
ja: ここのメインの人たちはマジでいい人ばっかでよ、俺たちのために家を建ててくれるって言ってて、それまではここにタダで泊まれるんだ。

key: But I don't get this 'pay it forward' condition, like if someone helps us, we gotta help someone else, and that's cool.
en: But I don't get this 'pay it forward' condition, like if someone helps us, we gotta help someone else, and that's cool.
ja: でもこの「恩送り」って条件がよくわからなくてよ、誰かに助けてもらったら、こっちも別の誰かを助けなきゃいけないってことだろ、それはいいんだけどさ。

key: But how am I supposed to know who needs help? I can't just go around asking every person I see, can I?
en: But how am I supposed to know who needs help? I can't just go around asking every person I see, can I?
ja: でも誰が助けを必要としてるかなんて、どうやってわかるんだよ? 見かけた奴全員に聞いて回るわけにもいかねえだろ?

key: Huh? They recruitin' down at the Coral Gym?
en: Huh? They recruitin' down at the Coral Gym?
ja: え? コーラルジムで人を募集してるって?

key: Well, I guess I'll mosey on over and see what I do them for.
en: Well, I guess I'll mosey on over and see what I do them for.
ja: まあ、ぶらっと行って、何をやらされるのか見てくるか。

key: Cheers!
en: Cheers!
ja: 乾杯!

key: Uh, guys, I'm pretty sure this place has a no-alcohol policy.
en: Uh, guys, I'm pretty sure this place has a no-alcohol policy.
ja: あの、ここって確か、飲酒禁止のはずだけど。

key: To another street way repaired!
en: To another street way repaired!
ja: また一つ、道路が直ったことに乾杯!

key: When this city stands tall and proud once more, we'll all know who was responsible for it!
en: When this city stands tall and proud once more, we'll all know who was responsible for it!
ja: この街がもう一度誇り高く立ち上がったとき、誰のおかげかみんなわかってるさ!

key: Our fingerprints are embedded in the very stone that makes this city!
en: Our fingerprints are embedded in the very stone that makes this city!
ja: 俺たちの指紋は、この街を作る石そのものに刻まれてるんだ!

key: This is our world now!
en: This is our world now!
ja: ここはもう俺たちの世界だ!

key: Ayyy, I'll drink to it!
en: Ayyy, I'll drink to it!
ja: おおー、それに乾杯だ!

key: Ugggh, can those guys just shut up already? I'm trying to concentrate here!
en: Ugggh, can those guys just shut up already? I'm trying to concentrate here!
ja: うう、あいつらいい加減黙ってくれない? こっちは集中したいんだけど!

key: Zzz...
en: Zzz...
ja: スー スー……

key: I'm glad we had to come here, or I wouldn't ever have made friends!
en: I'm glad we had to come here, or I wouldn't ever have made friends!
ja: ここに来ることになって良かった、じゃなきゃ友達なんてできなかったもん!

key: Yayyy! This place is just like staying in a hotel forever!
en: Yayyy! This place is just like staying in a hotel forever!
ja: わーい! ここってずっとホテルに泊まってるみたい!

key: The eternal optimism of the youth is something we should all aspire to.
en: The eternal optimism of the youth is something we should all aspire to.
ja: 若者の尽きることのない楽観主義は、私たちみんなが見習うべきものだね。

key: I'm glad my kid is having a better time than I am.
en: I'm glad my kid is having a better time than I am.
ja: 自分よりも子供の方が楽しく過ごせてるみたいで、良かったよ。

key: I had a fine home in Jasper some time ago, but after the incident there I had to leave.
en: I had a fine home in Jasper some time ago, but after the incident there I had to leave.
ja: 少し前まではジャスパーにいい家があったんだが、あそこであった事件のせいで出ていかざるを得なかった。

key: Now the whole ward's rebuilt, but they don't have me on the registration anymore.
en: Now the whole ward's rebuilt, but they don't have me on the registration anymore.
ja: 今じゃ区全体が再建されたっていうのに、俺はもう登録から外れちまってる。

key: Some luck I have...
en: Some luck I have...
ja: つくづく運がないもんだ……

key: Blankets, pillows, towels, rations here.
en: Blankets, pillows, towels, rations here.
ja: 毛布、枕、タオル、食料はこちらです。

key: If you're missing anything, please don't hesitate to ask!
en: If you're missing anything, please don't hesitate to ask!
ja: 何か足りないものがあれば、遠慮なくお申し付けください!

key: Our supplies are low, but we will do our best to provide for you as well as we can!
en: Our supplies are low, but we will do our best to provide for you as well as we can!
ja: 在庫は少ないですが、できる限りご用意できるよう頑張ります!

key: I haven't done a job app since high school...
en: I haven't done a job app since high school...
ja: 高校を出てから、就職活動なんてしたことないんだよな……

key: But anyway, how was I supposed to work when the city was such a mess before?
en: But anyway, how was I supposed to work when the city was such a mess before?
ja: つかそもそも、前の街があんな有様で、どうやって働けって言うんだよ?

key: Uh, this application wants professional references. I don't think I have one of those.
en: Uh, this application wants professional references. I don't think I have one of those.
ja: うわ、この申込書、職歴の照会先が要るのか。そんなのないんだけど。

key: Hey, you wanna pretend to be a reference for me?
en: Hey, you wanna pretend to be a reference for me?
ja: なあ、俺の照会先のフリしてくれない?

key: What's anyone supposed to do in a place like this anyway?
en: What's anyone supposed to do in a place like this anyway?
ja: つかこんな場所で、みんな一体何して過ごせばいいんだよ?

key: Watch TV? What TV?!
en: Watch TV? What TV?!
ja: テレビでも見ろって? どこにあるんだよ?!

key: Books! Who the fuck reads books in this day and age?!
en: Books! Who the fuck reads books in this day and age?!
ja: 本だあ? 今どき誰が本なんか読むんだよ、くそ!

key: Video games? You think we got money for that!
en: Video games? You think we got money for that!
ja: ゲームだって? そんな金があると思ってんのか!

key: It's not like video games can be free!
en: It's not like video games can be free!
ja: ゲームがタダで手に入るわけねえだろ!

key: About time they brought us some decent entertainment...
en: About time they brought us some decent entertainment...
ja: ようやくまともな娯楽を持ってきてくれるってわけか……

key: Even if the purple girl sucks.
en: Even if the purple girl sucks.
ja: あの紫の女がヘタクソでもな。

key: At least she's cute.
en: At least she's cute.
ja: まあ可愛いから許すか。

key: Better go find Aya...
en: Better go find Aya...
ja: アヤを探しに行ったほうがいいな……

key: Hey, you wanna make a bet?
en: Hey, you wanna make a bet?
ja: なあ、賭けをしないか?

key: Okay. I'll flip this coin. You call it. If you're right, I give you $1000. If you're wrong, you give me $1000.
en: Okay. I'll flip this coin. You call it. If you're right, I give you $1000. If you're wrong, you give me $1000.
ja: よし。このコインを投げるから、お前は表か裏か言え。当たったら1000ドルやるし、外れたら1000ドルよこせ。

key: Hey, what the heck? You don't even have that much!
en: Hey, what the heck? You don't even have that much!
ja: おい、なんだよ? そんな大金持ってねえだろ!

key: Get outta here, cheapskate!
en: Get outta here, cheapskate!
ja: けち臭えな、あっち行け!

key: And here we go!
en: And here we go!
ja: それじゃ行くぞ!

key: Caught it! What's it gonna be?
en: Caught it! What's it gonna be?
ja: キャッチした! どっちだ?

key: And it was...
en: And it was...
ja: 結果は……

key: Heads! Damn it!
en: Heads! Damn it!
ja: 表! くそっ!

key: Shoot! And I'm all outta cash, too!
en: Shoot! And I'm all outta cash, too!
ja: しまった! それに手持ちの金もねえ!

key: L-look, I can settle this!
en: L-look, I can settle this!
ja: み、見ろ、これで片をつけられる!

key: See here, I've got this cool TM I found!
en: See here, I've got this cool TM I found!
ja: ほら、拾ったこのイケてるわざマシンがあるんだ!

key: I'll sell it to you for all of the coin you've won from me!
en: I'll sell it to you for all of the coin you've won from me!
ja: お前が俺から勝ち取った金全部で、これを売ってやるよ!

key: What do you say? It's the best I can do.
en: What do you say? It's the best I can do.
ja: どうだ? これが精一杯だ。

key: Perfect! Okay, hand over the cash!
en: Perfect! Okay, hand over the cash!
ja: よし! じゃあ金をよこせ!

key: Wait, you don't even have the 4,000 you won from me?!
en: Wait, you don't even have the 4,000 you won from me?!
ja: おい、俺から勝ち取った4000ドルすら持ってないのか?!

key: What did you DO with it?
en: What did you DO with it?
ja: 一体それでどうしたんだよ?

key: But if that's how it is, then no deal!
en: But if that's how it is, then no deal!
ja: でもそれなら、この取引はナシだ!

key: Okay, here you go.
en: Okay, here you go.
ja: ほら、これでいいだろ。

key: Now let's call it square, all right?
en: Now let's call it square, all right?
ja: これでチャラってことでいいか?

key: Dude, no, you gotta buy it from me, it's all I can offer!
en: Dude, no, you gotta buy it from me, it's all I can offer!
ja: おい待てよ、これを買ってもらうしかないんだ、それしか出せるもんがねえんだよ!

key: I won't accept anything less than the full sum!
en: I won't accept anything less than the full sum!
ja: 全額じゃなきゃ受け取らねえぞ!

key: Uhh, but hey, if you don't want your winnings, I guess that's on you.
en: Uhh, but hey, if you don't want your winnings, I guess that's on you.
ja: まあ、勝った分を受け取らないってんなら、それはお前の勝手だけどな。

key: Fine, here you go.
en: Fine, here you go.
ja: わかったよ、ほら。

key: Tails! Hurrah!
en: Tails! Hurrah!
ja: 裏! やったぜ!

key: Fork it over, pal!
en: Fork it over, pal!
ja: よこせよ、相棒!

key: It'll take some Super Luck to beat me!
en: It'll take some Super Luck to beat me!
ja: 俺に勝つにはとんでもない強運がいるぜ!

key: Tails! Damn it!
en: Tails! Damn it!
ja: 裏! くそっ!

key: I'll sell it to you for all of the gold you've won from me!
en: I'll sell it to you for all of the gold you've won from me!
ja: お前が俺から勝ち取った金全部で、これを売ってやるよ!

key: Heads! Hurrah!
en: Heads! Hurrah!
ja: 表! やったぜ!

key: Tch, that's no fun.
en: Tch, that's no fun.
ja: ちっ、つまんねえな。

key: Shoot, this keeps happening.
en: Shoot, this keeps happening.
ja: くそ、また同じことの繰り返しだ。

key: My luck is terrible, so I lose everything and end up in a place like this...
en: My luck is terrible, so I lose everything and end up in a place like this...
ja: 俺は運が悪すぎて、何もかも失って、こんな場所に行き着いちまった……

key: Too many people here...
en: Too many people here...
ja: ここは人が多すぎる……

key: I can't stand it. I should go.
en: I can't stand it. I should go.
ja: 耐えられない。行かないと。

key: I should leave. You should go. You should leave.
en: I should leave. You should go. You should leave.
ja: 俺は出ていくべきだ。お前も行くべきだ。お前も出ていくべきだ。

key: Please leave. Please leave. Please leave.
en: Please leave. Please leave. Please leave.
ja: 頼むから出ていってくれ。頼むから出ていってくれ。頼むから出ていってくれ。

key: ARC: Well, if it isn't our guardian Champion!
en: ARC: Well, if it isn't our guardian Champion!
ja: アーク: おっと、これはこれは、俺たちの守護チャンピオンじゃねえか!

key: Was stoked to hear you'd be on the security sitch' for the show.
en: Was stoked to hear you'd be on the security sitch' for the show.
ja: 今回のショーの警備担当がお前だって聞いて、テンション上がったぜ。

key: I'm out here bustin' the beats for the gig.
en: I'm out here bustin' the beats for the gig.
ja: 俺はここでライブ用のビートをたたき出してる最中だ。

key: Kids needed a drummer, and asked me if I didn't know one.
en: Kids needed a drummer, and asked me if I didn't know one.
ja: ガキどもがドラマーを探してて、誰か知らないかって聞かれてさ。

key: I told them I didn't know a single person good for it, but that I had no shortage of machines that were.
en: I told them I didn't know a single person good for it, but that I had no shortage of machines that were.
ja: 適任な奴なんて一人も知らねえけど、それに見合う機材ならいくらでもあるって答えといた。

key: And here we are.
en: And here we are.
ja: で、こういうわけだ。

key: Pulled a few strings and got us set up here as a first show.
en: Pulled a few strings and got us set up here as a first show.
ja: ちょっと裏で手を回して、ここを最初の公演の場に用意したんだ。

key: We could do with some more practice, but there's no substitute for live experience.
en: We could do with some more practice, but there's no substitute for live experience.
ja: もう少し練習が要るところだが、生の経験に代わるものはねえからな。

key: The boys will definitely be fine, but...
en: The boys will definitely be fine, but...
ja: 野郎どもは間違いなく大丈夫だが……

key: Can't say I'm not concerned about Aya, her being a novice and all.
en: Can't say I'm not concerned about Aya, her being a novice and all.
ja: アヤは初心者だから、心配じゃないとは言えねえな。

key: It's trial by fire, but the stakes are low.
en: It's trial by fire, but the stakes are low.
ja: いきなり本番だが、リスクは低い。

key: These folks are happy to be seen; they won't mind a few missed chords.
en: These folks are happy to be seen; they won't mind a few missed chords.
ja: ここの連中は見てもらえるだけで喜んでくれる。コードを何個か外したって気にしねえよ。

key: ARC: I've got a few more things to set up before we get going, but why don't you check in with the others?
en: ARC: I've got a few more things to set up before we get going, but why don't you check in with the others?
ja: アーク: 始める前にまだいくつか準備があるが、先に他の連中に顔出してきたらどうだ?

key: HARDY: Glad you could make it, mate.
en: HARDY: Glad you could make it, mate.
ja: ハーディ: 来てくれてうれしいぜ、相棒。

key: I'm goin' over the set list right now.
en: I'm goin' over the set list right now.
ja: 今ちょうどセットリストを確認してるところなんだ。

key: Gotta practice my solos a bit more before we get goin', otherwise I'd be helping Aya out more...
en: Gotta practice my solos a bit more before we get goin', otherwise I'd be helping Aya out more...
ja: 始める前にソロをもうちょい練習しねえとな、じゃなきゃもっとアヤを手伝ってやれるんだが……

key: Poor girl's got some nerves on her.
en: Poor girl's got some nerves on her.
ja: かわいそうに、あいつはかなり緊張してる。

key: Understandable for a first timer, but we've had to resort to drastic measures.
en: Understandable for a first timer, but we've had to resort to drastic measures.
ja: 初めてなら仕方ねえけど、こっちも思い切った手段に出るしかなかった。

key: Pretty sure that's her middle name-- "Titania Drastic Measures Andersen."
en: Pretty sure that's her middle name-- "Titania Drastic Measures Andersen."
ja: あいつのミドルネームはきっとそれだぜ――「ティタニア・ドラスティック・メジャーズ・アンダーセン」。

key: She used to play bass when we were younger, so I thought she could help teach Aya,
en: She used to play bass when we were younger, so I thought she could help teach Aya,
ja: 昔ベースを弾いてたから、アヤに教えるのを手伝ってもらえるんじゃねえかと思ってな、

key: And believe me, I got a few drastic measures in my ear about it already myself.
en: And believe me, I got a few drastic measures in my ear about it already myself.
ja: しかも、そのことでもう俺自身の耳にも、思い切った説教が何発か入ってるぜ。

key: But I've got faith in 'em both, yanno?
en: But I've got faith in 'em both, yanno?
ja: でも二人とも信じてるんだ、わかるだろ?

key: It'll go great!
en: It'll go great!
ja: きっとうまくいくさ!

key: Gettin' to do this has been on my bucket list for a while, so I ain't lettin' the chance slide.
en: Gettin' to do this has been on my bucket list for a while, so I ain't lettin' the chance slide.
ja: これをやるのは前々からやり残しリストに入っててな、このチャンスを逃すつもりはねえぜ。

key: Only thing slidin' around here's gonna be my guitar, mark the words.
en: Only thing slidin' around here's gonna be my guitar, mark the words.
ja: ここで滑るとしたら俺のギターくらいのもんさ、覚えとけよ。

key: But I gotta focus still, so I'll see you once the curtain drops!
en: But I gotta focus still, so I'll see you once the curtain drops!
ja: とはいえまだ集中しねえとな、幕が下りたらまた会おうぜ!

key: ...The proverbial curtain, anyway.
en: ...The proverbial curtain, anyway.
ja: ……まあ、比喩的な意味での幕、だけどな。

key: HARDY: And like, da-da-dada ba, ba, ba...
en: HARDY: And like, da-da-dada ba, ba, ba...
ja: ハーディ: それで、ダダダダバ、バ、バ……

key: Nah, let's try...
en: Nah, let's try...
ja: いや、これでいこう……

key: Da-da dada, baaayaaayaaaa...
en: Da-da dada, baaayaaayaaaa...
ja: ダダダダ、バーヤーヤーヤー……

key: AYA: Like this...
en: AYA: Like this...
ja: アヤ: こんな感じ……

key: And this...
en: And this...
ja: それでこう……

key: And...
en: And...
ja: それで……

key: ...Tch, was it the second or third fret?
en: ...Tch, was it the second or third fret?
ja: ……ちっ、2フレット目だっけ、3フレット目だっけ?

key: TITANIA: Third.
en: TITANIA: Third.
ja: ティタニア: 3。

key: AYA: Ugh. I'm never going to remember this in time.
en: AYA: Ugh. I'm never going to remember this in time.
ja: アヤ: うう。こんなの間に合うまでに覚えられっこないよ。

key: Especially not while also having to worry about performing in front of people.
en: Especially not while also having to worry about performing in front of people.
ja: しかも人前で演奏することまで気にしなきゃいけないなんて。

key: Like, real, actual human people...
en: Like, real, actual human people...
ja: その、本物の、実在する人間たちの前で……

key: I should just sit out before I embarrass myself.
en: I should just sit out before I embarrass myself.
ja: 恥をかく前に、もう降りたほうがいいんじゃないかな。

key: TITANIA: Nope, you're in this.
en: TITANIA: Nope, you're in this.
ja: ティタニア: だめ、あんたはやるの。

key: I don't agree with my idiot brother putting you in front of a crowd as one of your first experiences playing,
en: I don't agree with my idiot brother putting you in front of a crowd as one of your first experiences playing,
ja: あたしのバカな弟が、演奏経験もろくにないあんたを最初から観客の前に立たせたことには賛成できないし、

key: And your idiot brother's not off the hook either,
en: And your idiot brother's not off the hook either,
ja: そのバカな弟のことも許すつもりはないけど、

key: But if you quit now, I'll have entirely wasted my time,
en: But if you quit now, I'll have entirely wasted my time,
ja: でも、今あんたが辞めたら、あたしの時間が丸々無駄になる。

key: More importantly, if you're going to quit, do it because you want out,
en: More importantly, if you're going to quit, do it because you want out,
ja: それに何より、辞めるなら、自分がやめたいからやめなさい。

key: Not because you're afraid of failing on the way in.
en: Not because you're afraid of failing on the way in.
ja: 失敗するのが怖いからじゃなくてね。

key: If you do that, you'll never learn anything.
en: If you do that, you'll never learn anything.
ja: そんな理由で辞めたら、あんたは何も学べない。

key: AYA: I'm beginning to think that the entire known world is conspiring to get me to make as big of a fool of myself as possible.
en: AYA: I'm beginning to think that the entire known world is conspiring to get me to make as big of a fool of myself as possible.
ja: アヤ: なんかもう、この世界のありとあらゆるものが、わたしをできる限り大恥かかせようと結託してる気がしてきた。

key: If that's what you all want, I can just go apply to Agate Circus.
en: If that's what you all want, I can just go apply to Agate Circus.
ja: それがみんなの望みなら、いっそアゲートサーカスに応募しに行けばいいんじゃない。

key: I'm sure they're hiring new clowns.
en: I'm sure they're hiring new clowns.
ja: きっと新しいピエロを募集してるだろうし。

key: At least I'd get paid for it there.
en: At least I'd get paid for it there.
ja: 少なくともあっちなら、給料はもらえるだろうし。

key: TITANIA: I'm not here to be your therapist, girl.
en: TITANIA: I'm not here to be your therapist, girl.
ja: ティタニア: あたしはあんたのセラピストじゃないんだけど。

key: Cut the fatalistic act and focus,
en: Cut the fatalistic act and focus,
ja: 諦めムード出すのはやめて、集中して。

key: Otherwise you can practice on your own.
en: Otherwise you can practice on your own.
ja: でなきゃ、一人で練習してなさい。

key: AYA: Geez, I was just joking...
en: AYA: Geez, I was just joking...
ja: アヤ: もう、冗談だってば……

key: TITANIA: Tell a joke you wouldn't actually believe.
en: TITANIA: Tell a joke you wouldn't actually believe.
ja: ティタニア: 自分でも信じられないような冗談を言いなさい。

key: Now get back to it; clock's ticking.
en: Now get back to it; clock's ticking.
ja: さあ戻って。時間がないんだから。

key: AYA: It's been like this all day...
en: AYA: It's been like this all day...
ja: アヤ: 今日一日ずっとこんな調子……

key: Hardy conned me into playing with him.
en: Hardy conned me into playing with him.
ja: ハーディにだまされて一緒に演奏させられたんだ。

key: It sounded fun until I got here and saw all the people.
en: It sounded fun until I got here and saw all the people.
ja: ここに来て観客を見るまでは、楽しそうに聞こえてたんだけど。

key: I don't suppose you could take me out back and just shoot me?
en: I don't suppose you could take me out back and just shoot me?
ja: 裏に連れてって、いっそ撃ち殺してくれたりしないよね?

key: TITANIA: Keep it up and I might.
en: TITANIA: Keep it up and I might.
ja: ティタニア: その調子だと、そうしちゃうかもね。

key: AYA: ...Right. Sorry.
en: AYA: ...Right. Sorry.
ja: アヤ: ……だよね。ごめん。

key: AYA: One and a two and a three and a...
en: AYA: One and a two and a three and a...
ja: アヤ: いち、に、さん、はい……

key: ...Sigh.
en: ...Sigh.
ja: ……はぁ。

key: LANA: AYA!!!
en: LANA: AYA!!!
ja: ラナ: アヤーッ!!!

key: LANA: Well, I heard you were playing and I just HAD to come see you!
en: LANA: Well, I heard you were playing and I just HAD to come see you!
ja: ラナ: だって演奏するって聞いたら、絶対見に来ないわけにいかないじゃない!

key: First a Gym Leader-- then a rockstar! Imagine!
en: First a Gym Leader-- then a rockstar! Imagine!
ja: 最初はジムリーダー――今度はロックスター! 信じられる?

key: AYA: Mom.
en: AYA: Mom.
ja: アヤ: ママ。

key: CAIN: Mother.
en: CAIN: Mother.
ja: カイン: 母上。

key: LANA: Oh, and you're here too.
en: LANA: Oh, and you're here too.
ja: ラナ: あら、あなたも来てたのね。

key: Nice of you to spend time with the family.
en: Nice of you to spend time with the family.
ja: 家族と時間を過ごしてくれるなんて、感心じゃない。

key: Tell me, is one of these fine gentlemen your boyfriend, or are all of them?
en: Tell me, is one of these fine gentlemen your boyfriend, or are all of them?
ja: ねえ教えて、このイケてる男の子たちの中に彼氏はいるの、それとも全員がそうなの?

key: HARDY: Ayo, I don't think that was entirely necessary.
en: HARDY: Ayo, I don't think that was entirely necessary.
ja: ハーディ: おいおい、それはさすがに、言わなくてもよかったんじゃねえか。

key: LANA: Honey, you're cute and all; great for my daughter-- just not for my son.
en: LANA: Honey, you're cute and all; great for my daughter-- just not for my son.
ja: ラナ: ハニー、あなたは可愛いし、うちの娘にはお似合いだけど――息子とは無しよ。

key: LANA: I'd date you myself if I were a few decades younger though!
en: LANA: I'd date you myself if I were a few decades younger though!
ja: ラナ: あたしが何十年か若かったら、自分でデートしたいくらいだけどね!

key: AYA: MOM.
en: AYA: MOM.
ja: アヤ: ママ。

key: TITANIA: You're interrupting a rehearsal. Leave.
en: TITANIA: You're interrupting a rehearsal. Leave.
ja: ティタニア: リハーサルの邪魔。出てって。

key: LANA: Touchy, touchy...
en: LANA: Touchy, touchy...
ja: ラナ: あらあら、怒りっぽいのね……

key: I'm only kidding...
en: I'm only kidding...
ja: ただの冗談じゃない……

key: TEZ: You will mind your tone when speaking to her if you know what's good for you.
en: TEZ: You will mind your tone when speaking to her if you know what's good for you.
ja: テズ: 彼女に向かってその口の利き方、身のためにも考えたほうがいいんじゃないか。

key: TITANIA: Should I know who this is?
en: TITANIA: Should I know who this is?
ja: ティタニア: これ誰だか知っとくべき?

key: AYA: That's, um... my--
en: AYA: That's, um... my--
ja: アヤ: それは、えっと……わたしの――

key: TEZ: I'm her father.
en: TEZ: I'm her father.
ja: テズ: 彼女の父親だ。

key: AYA: My STEP father.
en: AYA: My STEP father.
ja: アヤ: 義理の父親、ね。

key: LANA: This is Tez.
en: LANA: This is Tez.
ja: ラナ: この人はテズよ。

key: He's been very good to me ever since the divorce.
en: He's been very good to me ever since the divorce.
ja: 離婚してからずっと、すごく良くしてくれてるの。

key: AYA: That makes one of us...
en: AYA: That makes one of us...
ja: アヤ: 少なくとも一人には、ね……

key: TEZ: Excuse me?
en: TEZ: Excuse me?
ja: テズ: 何だと?

key: TEZ: If you have some kind of issue with me, then bring it to my face and we can discuss it like adults.
en: TEZ: If you have some kind of issue with me, then bring it to my face and we can discuss it like adults.
ja: テズ: 俺に何か言いたいことがあるなら、面と向かって、大人らしく話し合おうじゃないか。

key: But if you're just going to spew catty schoolyard passive aggression then keep it in your girls' club.
en: But if you're just going to spew catty schoolyard passive aggression then keep it in your girls' club.
ja: だが、学校の意地悪女子みたいな当てつけを吐き出すだけなら、女子会の中でやってくれ。

key: TITANIA: Sure, let's bring gender into this.
en: TITANIA: Sure, let's bring gender into this.
ja: ティタニア: いいわね、じゃあジェンダーの話も持ち出しましょうか。

key: Let's talk about how you've immediately stomped in here, bravado on full,
en: Let's talk about how you've immediately stomped in here, bravado on full,
ja: あんたが自信満々にここに踏み込んできて、

key: In one breath insinuating retaliation for disrespect,
en: In one breath insinuating retaliation for disrespect,
ja: 一息で無礼への報復をほのめかしたと思ったら、

key: And in the second demanding that your teenage ward confront you, an adult male, on equal footing,
en: And in the second demanding that your teenage ward confront you, an adult male, on equal footing,
ja: 次の一息で、十代の被後見人に、大人の男であるあんたと対等に向き合えって求める、

key: As if you wouldn't take any individual criticism she mustered as a personal attack.
en: As if you wouldn't take any individual criticism she mustered as a personal attack.
ja: そのくせ、彼女が何か批判をひねり出したら、それを個人攻撃だって受け取らないふりをする、

key: You consider yourself superior on a supposed moral ground that you maintain power in through brute intimidation alone,
en: You consider yourself superior on a supposed moral ground that you maintain power in through brute intimidation alone,
ja: 力ずくの威圧だけで維持してるくせに、道徳的に優れてるつもりでいる、

key: Because you know a girl half your age won't meet you on it when you can make her life hell.
en: Because you know a girl half your age won't meet you on it when you can make her life hell.
ja: だって、あんたの半分の歳の女の子の人生を地獄にできるとわかってれば、その子はあんたに対等になんて出られないもの。

key: TEZ: What the hell are you saying?
en: TEZ: What the hell are you saying?
ja: テズ: 一体何を言ってるんだ?

key: I said like two sentences and you're jumping down my throat for it?
en: I said like two sentences and you're jumping down my throat for it?
ja: たった二言くらい言っただけで、そこまで食ってかかるのか?

key: TITANIA: Three sentences.
en: TITANIA: Three sentences.
ja: ティタニア: 三言よ。

key: It only took that much for you to make an ass of yourself.
en: It only took that much for you to make an ass of yourself.
ja: それだけであんたは十分バカをさらしたってわけ。

key: And that's in public.
en: And that's in public.
ja: しかも人前でね。

key: I'd hate to see what you're like at home.
en: I'd hate to see what you're like at home.
ja: 家でどんな態度なのか、見たくもないわ。

key: HARDY: Heyyyy Sis, couldja maybe not go off like that on folks you just met?
en: HARDY: Heyyyy Sis, couldja maybe not go off like that on folks you just met?
ja: ハーディ: おいおい姉貴、会ったばっかの相手にそこまでかみつくのはやめてくんねえか?

key: CAIN: It's not like she's wrong.
en: CAIN: It's not like she's wrong.
ja: カイン: だって、姉さんの言ってること間違ってないし。

key: LANA: Aya, is this how you and your friends treat people?!
en: LANA: Aya, is this how you and your friends treat people?!
ja: ラナ: アヤ、あなたと友達は、みんなをこんな風に扱うの?!

key: You and I are going to have a talk about your influences, young lady!
en: You and I are going to have a talk about your influences, young lady!
ja: あなたが誰の影響を受けてるのか、後でじっくり話しましょうね!

key: TEZ: A long, serious talk.
en: TEZ: A long, serious talk.
ja: テズ: 長く、真剣な話をな。

key: AYA: Can everybody just shut up!?
en: AYA: Can everybody just shut up!?
ja: アヤ: みんな黙ってくれない!?

key: I literally didn't ask for any of this!
en: I literally didn't ask for any of this!
ja: こんなこと、こっちは何も頼んでない!

key: In fact, forget it-- I'm out.
en: In fact, forget it-- I'm out.
ja: つか、もういい――わたし抜ける。

key: ARC: Look, I don't know what's going on here, but for the sake of breaking the radio silence--
en: ARC: Look, I don't know what's going on here, but for the sake of breaking the radio silence--
ja: アーク: なあ、何が起きてるのかはわからねえが、この気まずい沈黙を破るためにも――

key: Someone should probably go after her.
en: Someone should probably go after her.
ja: 誰かがあいつを追いかけたほうがいいだろうな。

key: And given that the rest of you have done your respective parts to throw oil on the proverbial fire...
en: And given that the rest of you have done your respective parts to throw oil on the proverbial fire...
ja: それに、お前らはそれぞれ火に油を注ぐような真似をしてくれたわけだし……

key: It should probably be \PN.
en: It should probably be \PN.
ja: たぶん\PNしかいないだろ。

key: You go have a word with her.
en: You go have a word with her.
ja: 行って話してきてくれ。

key: I'll try to stop everyone else from killing each other while you're out.
en: I'll try to stop everyone else from killing each other while you're out.
ja: その間、俺は残りの連中が殺し合わねえように止めとくぜ。

key: TITANIA: Now B.
en: TITANIA: Now B.
ja: ティタニア: じゃあB。

key: E.
en: E.
ja: E。

key: Repeat.
en: Repeat.
ja: 繰り返して。

key: There.
en: There.
ja: そう、それ。

key: AYA: Ugh, how is anyone supposed to remember all these finger positions?
en: AYA: Ugh, how is anyone supposed to remember all these finger positions?
ja: アヤ: うう、こんな指の位置、誰が全部覚えられるっていうの?

key: TITANIA: Practice and muscle memory.
en: TITANIA: Practice and muscle memory.
ja: ティタニア: 練習と、体で覚えること。

key: Unfortunately my baby brother, in his continuing quest to embody all of the wisdom of a worn cinderblock, has not afforded you opportunity for those things.
en: Unfortunately my baby brother, in his continuing quest to embody all of the wisdom of a worn cinderblock, has not afforded you opportunity for those things.
ja: あいにく、あたしの弟は、使い古されたブロック並みの知恵を体現しようとし続けてるせいで、あんたにその機会を与えられてない。

key: So for today, you will focus on just hitting the first note of every sequence.
en: So for today, you will focus on just hitting the first note of every sequence.
ja: だから今日は、それぞれのフレーズの最初の音を弾くことだけに集中して。

key: If you can get the others, great.
en: If you can get the others, great.
ja: 他の音も弾ければ上出来。

key: But the first beat is your default; hit it and that'll be enough to fit a legal definition of 'playing'.
en: But the first beat is your default; hit it and that'll be enough to fit a legal definition of 'playing'.
ja: でも最初の一音が基本、それさえ弾ければ「演奏」の定義には十分間に合う。

key: You can practice hitting the third beat before the next rehearsal,
en: You can practice hitting the third beat before the next rehearsal,
ja: 次のリハーサルまでに、3拍目を弾く練習もしておいて。

key: And meanwhile I'll practice hitting some sense into your idiot "boyfriend".
en: And meanwhile I'll practice hitting some sense into your idiot "boyfriend".
ja: その間、あたしはあんたのバカな『彼氏』に説教をたたき込む練習をしとくから。

key: AYA: You could stand to go easier on him...
en: AYA: You could stand to go easier on him...
ja: アヤ: もう少し優しくしてあげてもいいと思うけど……

key: TITANIA: You could stand to go harder.
en: TITANIA: You could stand to go harder.
ja: ティタニア: あんたはもっと厳しくしてもいいと思うけど。

key: He only thinks about situations themselves; not how they affect the other people in them.
en: He only thinks about situations themselves; not how they affect the other people in them.
ja: あいつは状況そのものしか考えてなくて、それが周りにどう影響するかまでは考えてないから。

key: Hi, by the way.
en: Hi, by the way.
ja: ところで、どうも。

key: You're probably wondering what I'm doing here, and frankly, same.
en: You're probably wondering what I'm doing here, and frankly, same.
ja: あたしがここで何をしてるのか気になってるんでしょうけど、正直、あたしも同じ気持ち。

key: AYA: Hardy asked her to come help me with the bass.
en: AYA: Hardy asked her to come help me with the bass.
ja: アヤ: ハーディがベースを手伝ってくれって彼女に頼んだの。

key: Hardy was trying to teach me, and then suggested we make a band, and then this show happened, and...
en: Hardy was trying to teach me, and then suggested we make a band, and then this show happened, and...
ja: ハーディが教えようとしてくれて、それでバンドを組もうって言い出して、それでこのショーの話になって……

key: Well, I'm still useless at it.
en: Well, I'm still useless at it.
ja: でも、わたしはまだ全然使い物にならないんだけどね。

key: TITANIA: And our friendly local cinderblock remembered that I used to play as a teenager.
en: TITANIA: And our friendly local cinderblock remembered that I used to play as a teenager.
ja: ティタニア: それで、うちの気のいいブロック頭が、あたしが十代の頃に演奏してたことを思い出したってわけ。

key: So I have once again been called in to clean up his mess.
en: So I have once again been called in to clean up his mess.
ja: だから、また尻拭いのために呼び出されたの。

key: AYA: Sorry about all this again...
en: AYA: Sorry about all this again...
ja: アヤ: 改めて、いろいろごめん……

key: TITANIA: If you're really sorry, you can start apologizing by not calling yourself useless anymore.
en: TITANIA: If you're really sorry, you can start apologizing by not calling yourself useless anymore.
ja: ティタニア: 本当に悪いと思うなら、まず自分のことを使い物にならないって言うのをやめることから始めなさい。

key: It's not doing me any favors, and you least of all.
en: It's not doing me any favors, and you least of all.
ja: それはあたしのためにもならないし、あんた自身のためには一番ならないから。

key: AYA: Right...
en: AYA: Right...
ja: アヤ: そうだよね……

key: ...Thanks.
en: ...Thanks.
ja: ……ありがとう。

key: TITANIA: And if you want to thank me, you can do so by focusing on the play so I don't get called back here.
en: TITANIA: And if you want to thank me, you can do so by focusing on the play so I don't get called back here.
ja: ティタニア: それとお礼が言いたいなら、集中して演奏して、あたしがまたここに呼ばれないようにしてくれれば十分。

key: Go again; from the top.
en: Go again; from the top.
ja: もう一回、最初から。

key: TITANIA: Just let us do our thing.
en: TITANIA: Just let us do our thing.
ja: ティタニア: あたしたちにやらせておいて。

key: She'll be fine, if she can get over herself.
en: She'll be fine, if she can get over herself.
ja: 自分で自分を乗り越えられれば、あの子は大丈夫。

key: CAIN: Heyyyy \PN, you came!
en: CAIN: Heyyyy \PN, you came!
ja: カイン: やあやあ\PN、来てくれたんだね!

key: Okay, so this is kind of out of the blue, right?
en: Okay, so this is kind of out of the blue, right?
ja: まあ、いきなりって感じだよね?

key: But I was thinking, there's hardly anything I can see myself doing for a long time, but singing?
en: But I was thinking, there's hardly anything I can see myself doing for a long time, but singing?
ja: でもさ、これから長く続けられそうなことなんてほとんど思いつかないんだけど、歌うことなら?

key: I can do that.
en: I can do that.
ja: それならできるって思ったんだ。

key: I've wasted enough time running in circles, so even if I'm not 100% on a path in life, I've decided I need to at least start doing something.
en: I've wasted enough time running in circles, so even if I'm not 100% on a path in life, I've decided I need to at least start doing something.
ja: 堂々巡りする時間はもう十分無駄にしたし、人生の道が100パーセント決まってなくても、とにかく何か始めなきゃって決めたんだ。

key: So I started talking to Hardy about it,
en: So I started talking to Hardy about it,
ja: それでハーディにその話をし始めて、

key: And he mentioned he was already teaching Aya to play,
en: And he mentioned he was already teaching Aya to play,
ja: そしたら、もうアヤに演奏を教えてるって言ってきて、

key: And then we asked Arc if he knew anyone,
en: And then we asked Arc if he knew anyone,
ja: それでアークに誰か知らないか聞いてみたら、

key: And one thing led to another and now we're here making it happen!
en: And one thing led to another and now we're here making it happen!
ja: とんとん拍子に話が進んで、今こうして実現させてるってわけ!

key: We're not exactly rockstar material, but if we can make a few people smile for an evening, I'd say that's good enough!
en: We're not exactly rockstar material, but if we can make a few people smile for an evening, I'd say that's good enough!
ja: ロックスターの器ってわけじゃないけど、一晩でも何人かを笑顔にできるなら、それで十分だと思うんだ!

key: And these folks seem like they need a bit of that!
en: And these folks seem like they need a bit of that!
ja: それに、ここの人たちにはそういうのが必要そうだしね!

key: So you're keeping watch during rehearsal, right?
en: So you're keeping watch during rehearsal, right?
ja: それで、リハーサル中は見張り役ってことだよね?

key: I doubt anything'll happen, so feel free to keep all eyes on me~
en: I doubt anything'll happen, so feel free to keep all eyes on me~
ja: 何も起きないと思うから、遠慮なくわたしだけ見ててくれてもいいよ~

key: CAIN: I feel like it's been a while since I sang properly.
en: CAIN: I feel like it's been a while since I sang properly.
ja: カイン: ちゃんと歌うのは久しぶりな気がするなあ。

key: Maybe black hole time does that to a guy.
en: Maybe black hole time does that to a guy.
ja: ブラックホールで過ごした時間のせいかもね。

key: What's going on here?
en: What's going on here?
ja: 何が起きてるんだ?

key: Some kinda concert?
en: Some kinda concert?
ja: コンサートか何かか?

key: Here?
en: Here?
ja: ここで?

key: Sounds like a mistake...
en: Sounds like a mistake...
ja: 何かの間違いっぽいな……

key: They better not be makin' too much of a racket when it gets to be later...
en: They better not be makin' too much of a racket when it gets to be later...
ja: 遅い時間になってからうるさくするのはやめてほしいもんだが……

key: Some of us wanted to sleep while we could.
en: Some of us wanted to sleep while we could.
ja: こっちは寝れるうちに寝ときたいんだよ。

key: Wow, private shows too?
en: Wow, private shows too?
ja: うわ、貸切ライブまであるの?

key: This place is the best!
en: This place is the best!
ja: ここ最高じゃん!

key: Someday?
en: Someday?
ja: いつか?

key: I'm gonna play on the gey-tars too!
en: I'm gonna play on the gey-tars too!
ja: ぼくもぎたーひくんだ!

key: I'm already giving autographs though.
en: I'm already giving autographs though.
ja: もうサインくばってるけどね。

key: AYA: Um?
en: AYA: Um?
ja: アヤ: あれ?

key: Where... did everyone go?
en: Where... did everyone go?
ja: みんな……どこ行ったの?

key: Is this some kind of prank?
en: Is this some kind of prank?
ja: これって何かのドッキリ?

key: Cuz if so...
en: Cuz if so...
ja: もしそうなら……

key: Haha, gottem...?
en: Haha, gottem...?
ja: はは、引っかかった……?

key: Can we come out now...?
en: Can we come out now...?
ja: もう出てきてもいい……?

key: That a 'no'...?
en: That a 'no'...?
ja: それって『ノー』ってこと……?

key: AYA: Am I stating the obvious if I say something is really wrong here?
en: AYA: Am I stating the obvious if I say something is really wrong here?
ja: アヤ: 何かがおかしいって言ったら、当たり前すぎることを言ってる?

key: Something seemed strange when I entered the room, too...
en: Something seemed strange when I entered the room, too...
ja: 部屋に入ったときも、何か変な感じがしたし……

key: I... think maybe we should have a look around the building.
en: I... think maybe we should have a look around the building.
ja: その……建物の中を見て回ったほうがいいかもしれない。

key: Maybe we'll find them.
en: Maybe we'll find them.
ja: みんなが見つかるかもしれないし。

key: Or... something.
en: Or... something.
ja: それか……何かが。

key: HARDY: Thank you all for comin'!
en: HARDY: Thank you all for comin'!
ja: ハーディ: 来てくれてみんなありがとう!

key: Once again, shout out to the crew--
en: Once again, shout out to the crew--
ja: 改めて、クルーに拍手を――

key: DJ Arclight on rhythm and mixing!
en: DJ Arclight on rhythm and mixing!
ja: リズムとミキシングはDJアークライト!

key: My man, Cain, with that vocal veneer!
en: My man, Cain, with that vocal veneer!
ja: その伸びやかなボーカルは、俺の相棒カイン!

key: And last, but anything 'cept least, that's my girl Aya bumpin' it on the bass!
en: And last, but anything 'cept least, that's my girl Aya bumpin' it on the bass!
ja: 最後に、でも決して軽くはねえ、ベースで盛り上げてくれた俺たちの女の子アヤ!

key: One last shout out-- Thank you Reborn City!
en: One last shout out-- Thank you Reborn City!
ja: 最後にもうひとつ――ありがとう、リボーンシティ!

key: See you on the streets!
en: See you on the streets!
ja: また街で会おうぜ!

key: AYA: Son of a hellfuck, shit-ass fuck fuck fuck bitchfuck--
en: AYA: Son of a hellfuck, shit-ass fuck fuck fuck bitchfuck--
ja: アヤ: くそったれのくそ野郎、くそくそくそこのメス犬野郎が――

key: ASSDAMMIT.
en: ASSDAMMIT.
ja: くそったれがァ。

key: AYA: It's not like I didn't practice.
en: AYA: It's not like I didn't practice.
ja: アヤ: 練習しなかったわけじゃない。

key: I did practice! I practiced so much!
en: I did practice! I practiced so much!
ja: ちゃんと練習した! すごくたくさん練習した!

key: And yet I still messed up every single verse of the last song.
en: And yet I still messed up every single verse of the last song.
ja: それなのに、最後の曲のヴァースを全部失敗した。

key: And the solo!
en: And the solo!
ja: しかもソロも!

key: I think I managed about half a measure before I forgot every single note and went full Deerling-in-the- headlights!
en: I think I managed about half a measure before I forgot every single note and went full Deerling-in-the- headlights!
ja: 半小節くらいはなんとかなったと思うけど、そこから音を全部忘れて、完全にヘッドライトに固まったシキジカ状態になった!

key: Incredible, bravo!
en: Incredible, bravo!
ja: すごいね、拍手喝采!

key: What a wonder!
en: What a wonder!
ja: 見事なもんだよ!

key: I sure am "bumpin' it"--
en: I sure am "bumpin' it"--
ja: 確かに『盛り上げて』はいたよね――

key: In the "oops I'm sorry I bumped you and accidentally pushed you down two entire flights of stairs!" way.
en: In the "oops I'm sorry I bumped you and accidentally pushed you down two entire flights of stairs!" way.
ja: 「あ、ごめん、ぶつかって間違えて階段2階分も突き落としちゃった!」みたいな意味でだけど。

key: KID: Hey, 'scuse me?
en: KID: Hey, 'scuse me?
ja: 少年: ねえ、すみません?

key: Hey, are you the guitar girl from the show?
en: Hey, are you the guitar girl from the show?
ja: ねえ、さっきのショーのギターのお姉さんですか?

key: You are, right?
en: You are, right?
ja: そうですよね?

key: AYA: Uh... Technically it's a bass guitar, but...
en: AYA: Uh... Technically it's a bass guitar, but...
ja: アヤ: あ……厳密に言うとベースギターなんだけど……

key: KID: You were really super ultra cool!
en: KID: You were really super ultra cool!
ja: 少年: めちゃくちゃ超かっこよかったです!

key: Hey, where'd you learn to play?!
en: Hey, where'd you learn to play?!
ja: ねえ、どこで演奏習ったんですか?!

key: Hey, is that your natural hair color?
en: Hey, is that your natural hair color?
ja: ねえ、それ地毛の色ですか?

key: Hey, can I get an automagraph?
en: Hey, can I get an automagraph?
ja: ねえ、じどうサインってやつ、もらえます?

key: I wanna be just like you when I get bigger!
en: I wanna be just like you when I get bigger!
ja: ぼく、大きくなったらお姉さんみたいになりたい!

key: AYA: Uh, hey, wait, slow down there, kid...
en: AYA: Uh, hey, wait, slow down there, kid...
ja: アヤ: あ、ねえ、ちょっと待って、落ち着いて……

key: Um, in order--
en: Um, in order--
ja: ええと、順番に――

key: KID: Hey, wait, can you come with me?!
en: KID: Hey, wait, can you come with me?!
ja: 少年: ねえ待って、一緒に来てくれます?!

key: AYA: Uh, sure?
en: AYA: Uh, sure?
ja: アヤ: あ、うん?

key: KID: I wanna introduce you to my brother! He's gonna be so jealous that I got to meet you!
en: KID: I wanna introduce you to my brother! He's gonna be so jealous that I got to meet you!
ja: 少年: お兄ちゃんに紹介したいんです! ぼくが会えたって知ったら、めちゃくちゃ悔しがるだろうな!

key: Actually hey, wait, stay here, I'll bring him!
en: Actually hey, wait, stay here, I'll bring him!
ja: あ、やっぱりここで待ってて、連れてきます!

key: AYA: Sure thing, I'll-- Oh, okay bye.
en: AYA: Sure thing, I'll-- Oh, okay bye.
ja: アヤ: うん、それじゃ――あ、もう行っちゃった。

key: Uh, stay in school...
en: Uh, stay in school...
ja: ええと、ちゃんと学校に通ってね……

key: ...Or something.
en: ...Or something.
ja: ……みたいなことでも言っとくか。

key: AYA: ...Like me, huh?
en: AYA: ...Like me, huh?
ja: アヤ: ……わたしみたいに、か。

key: AYA: ...Could be worse, I guess.
en: AYA: ...Could be worse, I guess.
ja: アヤ: ……まあ、悪くはないのかも。

key: Yes
en: Yes
ja: はい

key: No
en: No
ja: いいえ

key: Heads
en: Heads
ja: 表

key: Tails
en: Tails
ja: 裏
